Start with a 5×5 chip-routing analogy

Pick a route around the blocked cells. The demo uses a toy four-direction grid; real chip routing needs additional physical checks. Tap a cell (other than S or G) to change whether it is blocked.

S at (0,0). G at (4,4). Blocked cells are marked ×.

Questions

Answers are not scripts to memorize. First explain the situation and why your choice helps. Then use the original technical vocabulary only if asked. For every source excerpt, follow inputs → checks → data changes → output.
Study order: role fundamentals → algorithms → physical design → optimization/ML → experiments → Resume Builder → Bounty Hub → AoA → VisionDev → Marvell.
